text: {"lessons":["I will avoid reacting to short-term swings: the account rose for several periods before falling, and I should judge decisions by my long-term plan.","A large gain in one stock alone is not a reason to sell; I will consider its role in my overall allocation and goals.","Because I check infrequently and rarely trade, I will keep a simple plan with clear review and rebalancing rules rather than make impulsive changes."]}
